text: deepseek-harness-pets 是面向 DSH Web 的桌宠插件：Host 侧注册皮肤设置，浏览器侧把宠物放进常驻悬浮层，并根据 turn、step 和工具事件切换加载、推理、评分、完成或失败状态。用户可拖动桌宠、点击触发跳跃，也可设置随机或指定皮肤；它还扫描自定义、Petdex 与内置皮肤目录。适合希望在 DSH 会话中获得状态动画提示的 Web 用户。安装需 Node.js 22 及 DSH Web 环境；当前已读绘制代码显示为固定鲸鱼图形。

deepseek-harness-pets adds a desktop pet to DSH Web. It mounts a floating overlay and changes its state in response to turn, step, and tool events. Users can drag or click it and select a named or random skin. It requires Node.js 22; the reviewed renderer currently draws a fixed whale graphic.
想让 DSH Web 里的小宠物随着每轮对话显示不同状态
有没有能在 DSH 页面角落常驻的桌宠
我想拖动网页里的宠物，并在刷新后保留它的位置
让桌宠在空闲、推理和完成时切换动画
能不能点一下悬浮宠物让它做个动作
Show a small pet that reacts to each DSH conversation turn
I want a draggable floating companion in the DSH web interface
Can the page pet remember where I placed it after reload?
deepseek-harness-pets 的功能「会话状态动画」：悬浮宠物读取 turn、step 和工具事件，在加载、推理、评分、完成或失败等状态间切换。
deepseek-harness-pets 的功能「可拖动悬浮窗」：用户可在页面内拖动宠物，位置限制在视口范围内，并在松开后保存位置供下次载入。
deepseek-harness-pets 的功能「点击与闲置动作」：点击宠物触发短暂跳跃反馈；空闲时会定时出现小动作和气泡。
deepseek-harness-pets 的功能「皮肤来源与选择」：Host 扫描自定义、Petdex 和随包目录并合并可选 slug，设置支持指定皮肤或按回合确定性随机选择。
deepseek-harness-pets 的功能「按回合挑选宠物」：每个 turn 开始时根据设置与回合标识选择皮肤，并让该轮事件驱动对应桌宠状态。
deepseek-harness-pets 当前悬浮层直接绘制固定鲸鱼 SVG；虽然 Host 扫描皮肤目录并提供 slug 设置，已读绘制代码未显示按所选皮肤加载图像。

deepseek-harness-pets README · deepseek-harness-pets：English | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

> A desktop pet for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — a whale that swims in the corner of your Web UI and reacts to your agent's turns.

deepseek-harness-pets README · deepseek-harness-pets：A persistent little whale floats in the **bottom-right corner** of the DSH Web UI (`shell.overlay` slot — never touches your chat stream). It bobs while idle, braces while loading, swims hard while inferring, reviews while scoring, waves when a turn completes, leaps on SOTA, and floats belly-up on failure. Click it, hover it, drag it — it's a real pet.

deepseek-harness-pets README · deepseek-harness-pets：Pet skins follow the [Petdex](https://github.com/crafter-station/petdex) standard (`pet.json` + 8×9 spritesheet), so assets interop with the Petdex desktop overlay and the petdex.dev community gallery.

deepseek-harness-pets README · See it in action：Live captures from a real `dsh web` session (dsh 0.1.0-rc.5, zero console errors):

| Idle — bobbing doze, zzZ | Hover — "huh?" | Click — happy hop + cheer | Dragged — position persists |
|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
|  |  |  |  |

Drag it anywhere inside the viewport — the position is clamped and survives reloads (`localStorage`). Full set: [docs/screenshots/](docs/screenshots/).

deepseek-harness-pets README · Install：Two commands (v0.2.2+ on npm):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add deepseek-harness-pets
dsh web
```

Open `http://localhost:3080` — the whale is already there. Full guide (prerequisites, source checkout, hand-written patch row, troubleshooting): [docs/installation.md](docs/installation.md).

deepseek-harness-pets README · State mapping：Three-layer contract: **dsh event signal → plugin semantic state → overlay CSS animation + bubble**. Machine-readable: [mappings/harness-states.json](mappings/harness-states.json).

deepseek-harness-pets README · State mapping：| dsh signal | State | Overlay visual / bubble |
|---|---|---|
| session idle | `idle` | bobbing doze / zzZ |
| `turn/start` first prep | `loading` | buoyant anticipation / Loading data… |
| `step/start`, tool activity | `inferring` | swimming sway / Inferring… |
| report/scoring tools | `scoring` | leaning review / Scoring… |
| `turn/end` completed | `done` | fin waving / Done! |
| completion with SOTA text | `sota` | leap + splash / SOTA! |
| `turn/end` failed | `error` | belly-up grayscale / [ERROR] check logs |

deepseek-harness-pets README · State mapping：Animations are driven by the `OVERLAY_ANIMATIONS` table in `src/pet-art.js` (CSS transform keyframes over the official DeepSeek whale SVG). The Petdex 9-row set remains the asset contract for the future spritesheet switch point.

deepseek-harness-pets README · Configuration：`~/.dsh/settings.yaml` (user layer) or the profile patch layer:

```yaml
deepseek-harness-pets:
  pet: random   # deepseek-whale (default) | deepseek-octo | random (deterministic per turn id)
```

Skin discovery scans three sources, highest priority first: `~/.dsh/pets` (custom) > `~/.petdex/pets` (community) > bundled `assets/pets`. Details: [docs/installation.md](docs/installation.md#configuring-the-pet).

deepseek-harness-pets README · Creating a skin：Each pet is a standard Petdex package under `assets/pets/<slug>/` — contribute one via PR (`pet/<slug>` branch), or keep it local in `~/.dsh/pets/` where it always wins. Frame spec: 8×9 grid, 192×208 per frame, magenta `#FF00FF` background, row order idle→review. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) and each pet's `spritesheet.README.md`.

deepseek-harness-pets README · Release：Published to npm by GitHub Actions via [trusted publishing](https://docs.npmjs.com/) (OIDC, zero tokens): push a `v*` tag → CI verifies (tests, build, artifact-drift gate) → publishes with provenance. Maintainer runbook: [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). Changelog: [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).
